review_locator: PMCID:PMC3357554, Microglial Microvesicle Secretion and Intercellular Signaling; PMCID:PMC10298639, P2X7 Receptor and Extracellular Vesicle Release
primary_title: Acid sphingomyelinase activity triggers microparticle release from glial cells
decision_basis: The reviews lead to the primary study showing that ATP/P2X7 activation rapidly activates and translocates acid sphingomyelinase to the plasma membrane in glial cultures, with inhibition or genetic loss reducing microparticle shedding and IL-1beta release.
limitations_preserved: Preserve acid sphingomyelinase/SMPD1 enzyme-activity semantics, glial-cell and BzATP/P2X7 context, and the pathway-to-vesicle boundary; do not infer SMPD1 transcription, a direct P2X7-SMPD1 physical complex, traumatic-SCI relevance or terminal-TF effects.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3357554, Microglial Microvesicle Secretion and Intercellular Signaling; PMCID:PMC10298639, P2X7 Receptor and Extracellular Vesicle Release
primary_title: Acid sphingomyelinase activity triggers microparticle release from glial cells
decision_basis: The reviews lead to the primary study showing P2X7-dependent glial plasma-membrane microparticle shedding in microglia and astrocytes, with receptor antagonism, calcium chelation and acid-sphingomyelinase perturbation reducing release.
limitations_preserved: P2X7-dependent glial plasma-membrane microparticle shedding is directly supported in the cited primary study; preserve microglia/astrocyte, BzATP, calcium, acid-sphingomyelinase and microparticle context, distinguish vesicle release from IL1B transcription and do not infer a single cargo, traumatic-SCI relevance or terminal-TF effects.
